verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly claim Claude Code reads issues, writes code, runs tests, and submits PRs end-to-end (docs-16, docs-3, docs-11), suggesting full issue-to-PR automation. However, community reports describe significant reliability problems—self-verification failures, careless replace-all bugs, and even a user reporting a '100% failure rate' over a month—casting doubt on how reliably this end-to-end flow actually works in practice.
